title: Hamburger is shown and desktop nav is hidden on mobile
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
expected_result: The header shows the logo, a search icon and a hamburger icon. The desktop nav links are not displayed.

title: Hamburger opens the menu with all expected items
test_data: Expected items: Products, Portfolio, Resources, About, Contact, Get a Quote, Get a Sample
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Read the items of the opened menu
expected_result: The menu opens and lists Products, Portfolio, Resources, About, Contact, Get a Quote and Get a Sample.

title: Menu opening slides the page and shows the menu panel
test_data: Expected: page content slides left; dark-blue menu panel
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Observe the page content and the menu panel
expected_result: The page content slides to the left and a dark-blue menu panel is shown; no content overlaps the menu items.

title: Menu item navigates to the correct page
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
expected_result: URL becomes /contact/ and the Contact page loads (HTTP 200, no error page).

title: Menu can be closed and the page returns to normal
test_data: Close control: hamburger icon (or close icon if shown)
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Tap the hamburger icon to open the menu
Tap the same control again (or the close icon)
expected_result: The menu closes, the page content slides back, and the /about/ page is fully visible and scrollable.

title: Search icon is available next to the hamburger on mobile
test_data: Control: search icon in the mobile header
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Tap the search icon in the header
expected_result: A search input becomes visible; it can be closed again without leaving the page.

title: Hamburger is not shown on desktop
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Look at the header and check whether #menu-burger-opener is displayed
expected_result: The hamburger is not displayed; the full desktop nav is shown instead.
